logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

scenes.heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Urgent, Whispering)
events.content: "Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Quiet)
events.content: "No one will recognize me dressed like this."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning)
events.content: "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Determined)
events.content: "The Duchess is dying."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)
events.content: "I saved Toby. I can save her."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Fretful)
events.content: "And if they discover who you are?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Selfless)
events.content: "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn)
events.content: "Then forget you were ever a lady."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Quietly Resolute)
events.content: "Today, I am only a maid."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Sharp, Stern, O.S.)
events.content: "Prudence."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Suspicious)
events.content: "Who is this?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Submissive)
events.content: "Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Cold, Skeptical)
events.content: "She looks soft."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Humble, Steady)
events.content: "I can work, ma'am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Demanding)
events.content: "Can you scrub stone?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued)
events.content: "Yes, ma'am."

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Harsh, O.S.)
events.content: "Carry coal?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Polite)
events.content: "Yes, ma'am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Menacing, Threatening)
events.content: "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Steady)
events.content: "Yes, ma'am."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.

events.label: HOUSEKEEPER (Stern, Dismissive)
events.content: "Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Relieved, Whispering)
events.content: "That was close."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Quiet)
events.content: "Where is the West Wing?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning)
events.content: "Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there."

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Breathless)
events.content: "This house..."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Panicked, Hushed)
events.content: "Do not stare. Keep walking."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Concerned)
events.content: "Your Grace?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Soft, Comforting)
events.content: "Do not speak."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Murmuring)
events.content: "This isn't ordinary fever."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Alarmed)
events.content: "Who has been treating you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.
